evidence.title: aizen.win
evidence.locator: hero, pricing section, feature list, footer
evidence.finding: macOS-only (Apple Silicon) workspace; Free $0 with the full core workspace, Pro $59/yr (or $5.99/mo) and Lifetime $179 add support for development, priority support and future paid extras; ACP agents such as Claude, Codex, OpenCode and Gemini; open source under GPL-3.0; links to Privacy, Terms and Refunds.

evidence.title: GitHub repository metadata
evidence.finding: 311 stars, license reported as GPL-3.0, homepage aizen.win, not archived, pushed 2026-08-01.

evidence.title: Aizen v1.0.83 release
evidence.finding: Final 1.0.x release (2026-07-25): isolates Files and Browser state per pane, moves agent selection into pane headers, fixes browser restoration; next release will be 2.0.0 and not backward-compatible; no assets attached (builds come from aizen.win and the Sparkle appcast).

evidence.title: Aizen README
evidence.locator: What is Aizen; Current Highlights; Requirements; Agent Setup; CLI; Dependencies
evidence.finding: Agentic-first macOS workspace: per-project and per-branch environments with terminal (libghostty), files, browser and ACP agent chat; Git, diff and review; GitHub Actions and GitLab CI; MCP marketplace; voice; CLI companion; macOS 13.5+ Apple Silicon only; GPL-3.0; roadmap note on the 2.0.0 reimagining.

evidence.title: GNU GPL v3
evidence.finding: GNU General Public License version 3 (standard text including the or-any-later-version template); no source header grants later versions.

evidence.title: Agent instructions and architecture
evidence.finding: macOS developer tool for Git worktrees with terminal, file browser, web browser and ACP AI agents; feature-first Swift architecture.

evidence.title: ACP registry agents spec
evidence.finding: Registry-first agent model with seeded Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode, Add From Registry and Add Custom Agent; binary, npx and uvx distribution.

evidence.title: Pro feature gating spec
evidence.finding: Design spec for gating (1 workspace and 1 custom agent free, PR/CI surfaces Pro); a spec only, not evidence of shipped gating.

evidence.title: Umami app analytics spec
evidence.finding: Anonymous product analytics on a self-hosted Umami, enabled by default with a visible setting to disable; no prompts, paths, repository names or chat content.

evidence.title: Agent environment variables spec
evidence.finding: Custom environment variables per agent with sensitive values stored in the Keychain.

evidence.title: ACP agent session
evidence.finding: Agent Client Protocol session client per chat: prompt lifecycle, streaming, tool calls, attachments, resume and replay, authentication.

evidence.title: Agent permission handler
evidence.finding: Surfaces ACP permission requests to the user and returns the chosen option; a notification coordinator alerts when the app is inactive.

evidence.title: Agent defaults
evidence.finding: Seeds Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode registry agents; registry store supports custom agents.

evidence.title: Agent registry bootstrap
evidence.finding: Bootstraps registry agents and validates executables.

evidence.title: MCP server store
evidence.locator: MCPRegistryService, per-agent defaults and session overrides
evidence.finding: MCP marketplace and per-agent and per-session MCP server configuration.

evidence.title: Git worktree service
evidence.finding: Creates git worktrees with libgit2; environments can also be folders or copies.

evidence.title: Linked environment creation
evidence.finding: Workspace store creates linked environments through the worktree service.

evidence.title: PR actions through gh and glab
evidence.finding: Creates (opens web flow), diffs, merges and closes pull requests and merge requests through the gh and glab CLIs.

evidence.title: PR comments
evidence.finding: Reads PR and MR comments through the CLIs.

evidence.title: Workflow providers
evidence.locator: GitHub Actions and GitLab CI providers
evidence.finding: Lists workflow runs, logs and actions for GitHub Actions and GitLab CI from the worktree sidebar.

evidence.title: Review session store
evidence.finding: Stores local review sessions and comments on diffs.

evidence.title: aizen CLI
evidence.finding: Swift CLI that opens projects, lists workspaces and attaches to tmux-backed terminals using the app's store.

evidence.title: Analytics settings
evidence.finding: Anonymous Umami analytics default on with a toggle in Settings, General.

evidence.title: Analytics toggle
evidence.finding: Settings toggle that disables usage analytics.

evidence.title: App Info.plist
evidence.finding: Sparkle update feed hosted by the vendor.

evidence.title: Support Aizen button
evidence.finding: The only use of license state in the sidebar toggles a Support Aizen button; no feature is gated on it in this release.

evidence.title: Review comments as chat attachment
evidence.finding: Review comments are attached to the agent chat input as Markdown.

evidence.title: Voice input
evidence.finding: On-device voice input and recording services.

evidence.title: Chat persistence
evidence.locator: Core Data session persistence and resume
evidence.finding: Chat sessions persist in Core Data and resume.

evidence.title: tmux cleanup
evidence.finding: Optional tmux-backed terminal persistence with cleanup of orphaned sessions.

evidence.title: Bounded search: users, roles, SSO and sharing
evidence.finding: No accounts, roles, SSO or shared sessions; the only account concept is the Pro license.

evidence.title: Bounded search: remote execution and mobile
evidence.locator: grep -Eni remote worker|ssh server|vps|cloud runner|ios app|android over aizen/ and cli/; Requirements section
evidence.finding: No remote execution, cloud runner, headless server or mobile client; Apple Silicon macOS only.

evidence.title: Bounded search: native issue tracker
evidence.finding: No native issue or task backlog; environments carry a status filter (ItemStatus) and notes only.

evidence.title: Bounded search: living specifications
evidence.locator: grep -Eni living spec|requirements|drift over docs/specs and aizen
evidence.finding: docs/specs are internal engineering specs for Aizen itself, not a product feature.

evidence.title: Bounded search: cost, usage and limits
evidence.locator: grep -Eni token usage|cost|budget|limit|timeout over aizen/Features/Chat and Settings
evidence.finding: No token, cost or budget display or limits in the chat; only ACP protocol state.

evidence.title: Bounded search: schedules and triggers
evidence.locator: grep -Eni schedule|cron|automation|webhook|trigger over aizen/Features and cli/
evidence.finding: No scheduler, event triggers or webhooks.
